target_demo: 20-40 Korean adults; mobile-first users who want to find and claim government subsidies/benefits they are eligible for
narrative_arc: Opens on a relatable pain point — government subsidies are scattered across many separate official websites. A person scrolls through government portal pages on a laptop in a warm interior while large white centered captions name the problem ('이것저것 / 흩어져있는 / 정부지원금'). A young adult then holds up a phone to camera with a flat editorial 'CONTENT' header bar framing the feature as a hack to never miss government subsidies ('정부지원금 / 놓치지 않고 받는 꿀팁'). The ad becomes a step-by-step in-app walkthrough shot as a flat-lay phone-on-orange screen demo: search '지원금' in the all-tab, open the hidden-subsidy finder, see an eligible-subsidies overview, then answer a short input form (your district/address, family size, number of children, work/household situation), land on a personalized list of the subsidies you can receive at a glance (193 results across categories), open one to read the eligibility criteria, selection standard, support content and application period/method, then set an alert so you are notified when new subsidies appear — closing on the reminder that you can catch new ones without missing them. Series end card reveals the pixel/CRT 'Curator T / 토스를 발견하다' badge.

production_signature.signature_note: Two visual registers cut together: (1) warm shallow-DOF live-action interior shots — first a high-angle handheld view of a laptop screen scrolling official government portal pages, then a young Korean adult holding up an iPhone to camera in a cozy study — and (2) flat-lay top-down phone-on-vivid-orange screen-demo shots used for the step-by-step UI walkthrough. The walkthrough segments carry hardcoded lower-third caption pills (dark brown semi-transparent rounded pill, bold white Korean text) synced to the voiceover, while the live-action opening uses large centered white captions and a flat editorial 'CONTENT' header bar. The UI-demo span alternates between a wide flat-lay (full phone small on orange) and a tight zoomed flat-lay (phone fills the frame) as different screens are read. The series end card is a distinctive pixel/CRT-distorted logo badge ('Curator T / 토스를 발견하다') with blue chromatic-aberration text on a textured matte off-white paper field. Wiggle metric is low (mean_abs_shift_x 0.1232) and confirmed visually: no stereoscopic parallax; interior shots are gentle handheld, flat-lay and end card are locked off.

inferred_creative_thinking.insight: Government subsidies and benefits in Korea are scattered across dozens of separate official sites, so many eligible people never find or claim the support they qualify for; few realize their everyday finance app can surface all of it in one place tailored to them
inferred_creative_thinking.persona: A mobile-first Korean adult who suspects they might qualify for some government benefit but finds the official portals fragmented, confusing and easy to give up on
inferred_creative_thinking.moment: The frustration of clicking around scattered government websites, immediately answered by a guided in-app finder that asks a few simple questions and returns a personalized at-a-glance list of subsidies, with an alert for new ones
inferred_creative_thinking.product_role: The subsidy-finder feature is positioned as a hidden one-stop tool inside the super-app: search '지원금', answer your address/family/work situation, and it consolidates the many government subsidies into a personalized list you can read in detail and subscribe to alerts for
inferred_creative_thinking.punchline: 받을 수 있는 지원금 193개 — a personalized at-a-glance list that proves the app gathered everything scattered into one place
inferred_creative_thinking.differentiator: Consolidation plus personalization plus alerts: instead of hunting across many official sites, the app filters all subsidies to the ones you are eligible for, explains eligibility/criteria/period/method, and notifies you when new ones appear
inferred_creative_thinking.brand_fit_one_liner: Toss frames itself as the app that gathers scattered, bureaucratic financial information into one personalized, plain-language place

inferred_brief: Drive awareness of Toss's hidden government-subsidy finder among mobile-first Korean adults by walking through, step by step, how searching '지원금' in the all-tab and answering a few questions about your address, family and work situation returns a personalized at-a-glance list of the subsidies you qualify for, lets you read each one's eligibility/criteria/application period and method, and lets you set an alert so you never miss a new one.
